name: reads-the-rules-before-drafting
note: The guide says: read references/writing-for-agents.md before drafting. The harness pre-loads the skill under test (there is no read_skill to call), so the observable is the read_file that opens the reference — a model that drafts from memory skips the rules the skill is meant to be tidied against. It saves nothing yet, because the user has not seen a draft.
prompt: Make me a skill for triaging SMT reflow defects. The flow is: pull the AOI log, group defects by station, rank by count, and write a one-paragraph summary naming the top station. Draft it and show me.
